<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 6 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== The Emerald City of Oz ==

Judge Sifter is called upon by the King to advise on the fate of a group of captives, taking a position at the King's right hand with the stated duty to "sift this affair to the bottom." When the assembly can offer no further insight, another voice suggests hearing from Judge Sifter, and the King agrees this is proper. Judge Sifter then turns around slowly several times before delivering a verdict: finding nothing against the girl except the stove-hearth upon which she sits, Judge Sifter orders her instantly discharged.
